```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(openxlsx)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)
library(tidyverse)
source("src", "utils.R") # load custom functions

file <- "CCL4_Ca_Master_V2.xlsx"
dir <- dirname(file)
ca_data <- read.xlsx(file, sheet = "Sheet1")
ca_data$Condition <- factor(ca_data$Condition, levels = c("Vehicle", "CCL4"))
```

```{r n}
n <- ca_data |> group_by(Condition) |> summarise(n=n())
```

```{r percentage of responders}
##Settings
COND <- "CCL4" #c("Vehicle", "CCL4")

# plot
ca_data |> 
  mutate(Responder = as.factor(Responder)) |>
  group_by(Responder, Condition) |>
  summarise(n = n()) |>
  group_by(Condition) |>
  mutate(percent = n/sum(n)*100) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Condition, y = percent, fill = Responder)) +
  geom_col(color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("white", "red")) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(n)), position = position_stack(vjust=0.5)) +
  theme_classic()

saveThePlot(file.path(dir, paste0("Cap_Responders_Bar_")),  w = 3, h = 4)

# Fishers
ca_data |> 
  mutate(Responder = as.factor(Responder)) |>
  group_by(Responder, Condition) |>
  summarise(n = n()) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = Condition, values_from = n) |>
  column_to_rownames(var = "Responder") |>
  as.matrix() |>
  fisher.test()
```

```{r donor and coverslip aware cap response proportions}
ca_data |> 
  mutate(Responder = as.factor(Responder)) |>
  group_by(Donor, Responder, Condition) |>
  summarise(n = n()) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Responder,
    values_from = n,
  ) |>
  mutate(prop = `1` / (`0` + `1`) * 100) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Condition, y = prop)) +
  geom_point()
  geom_col(color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("white", "red")) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(n)), position = position_stack(vjust=0.5)) +
  theme_classic()
  
  
ca_lm <- ca_data |> 
  mutate(Responder = as.factor(Responder)) |>
  group_by(Responder, Condition, Donor, Coverslip) |>
  summarise(n = n()) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Responder,
    values_from = n,
  ) |>
 mutate(prop = `1` / (`0` + `1`) * 100) 

library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
lm <- as.formula("prop ~ Condition + (1 | Donor) + (1 | Coverslip)")
fit <- lmer(lm, data = ca_lm, REML = TRUE)
summary(fit)
capture.output(summary(fit), file = file.path(dir, paste0(measure, "_Responder.txt")))
```


Diff analysis for responders

```{r diff, echo=FALSE}
# Diff analysis of responder trace qualities
measures <- c("Baseline", "Cap.ENH_PC_Response", "AUC.Cap_ENH2", "Time.to.Peak.in.Cap_ENH2", "KCl_PC_Response")
for(measure in measures) {
  ca_filter <- ca_data |> filter(Responder == 1)
  
  # t-test
  comp <- ca_filter |> t_test(formula(paste0(measure, " ~ Condition"))) |>
    add_significance()
  print(comp)
  write.csv(comp, file=file.path(dir, paste0(measure, "_Responders_T-Test_", Sys.Date(), ".csv")))
  
   #  wilcox
  comp <- ca_filter |> wilcox_test(formula(paste0(measure, " ~ Condition"))) |>
    add_significance()
  print(comp)
  write.csv(comp, file=file.path(dir, paste0(measure, "_Responders_Wilcox_", Sys.Date(), ".csv")))
  
  # shapiro
  sw <- ca_filter |> group_by(Condition) |> shapiro_test(measure)
  write.csv(sw, file=file.path(dir, paste0(measure, "_Responders_Shapiro_", Sys.Date(), ".csv")))
  
  ###BARPLOT
  plot <- ca_filter |> group_by(Condition) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = Condition,
               y = .data[[measure]], base = 2)) +
    stat_summary(aes(color = Condition), fun.data="mean_se", geom="errorbar", width = 0.2) +  # add error bars
    stat_summary(aes(color = Condition), geom = "col", fun = "mean", position = "dodge", fill = "white") +
    geom_point(aes(color = Condition, shape = factor(Donor)), size = 1, alpha = 0.5, position = position_jitter(width = 0.2)) +
    scale_alpha_manual(values=c(1, 1)) +
    scale_color_manual(values=c("black", "red")) +
    scale_shape_manual(values=c(16,17,15)) +
    expand_limits(x = 0, y = 0) +
    guides(x = guide_axis(angle=45)) + # angle
    theme_classic() +
    theme(axis.title.x=element_blank())
  
  if(any(c("*", "**", "***", "****") %in% pwc$p.adj.signif)) { # stat_pvalue_manual throws an error if no signif p.adj results
    pwc <- pwc |> add_xy_position(x = "Condition", fun = "max") # compute coords of p-values 
   plot <- plot + stat_pvalue_manual(pwc, label = "p.adj", hide.ns = T, 
                                     tip.length = 0.01)
  }
  plot
  saveThePlot(file.path(dir, paste0(measure, "_Responders_BarPlot")),  w = 3, h = 3.5)
  
  
  # violin with per-donor line plot
  plot <- ca_filter |> group_by(Condition) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = Condition,
               y = .data[[measure]], base = 2)) +
    ###VIOLIN WITH PER DONOR
    geom_violin(aes(fill=Condition)) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = factor(Donor)), position = position_jitter(width=0.3), 
               size = 0.5, color="black", linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.3) +  # add indiv values
    scale_shape_manual(values=c(1,2,4)) +
    stat_summary(aes(color=factor(Donor)), fun.y="mean", geom="line", group = 1, linewidth = 0.4) +
    stat_summary(aes(shape = factor(Donor)), fun.y="mean", geom="point", group = 1, size = 2) +  # add indiv values
    stat_summary(aes(alpha = factor(Donor)), fun.data="mean_se", geom="errorbar", group = 1, width = 0.2) +  # add error bars
    scale_color_manual(values=c("black", "black", "black")) +
    scale_alpha_manual(values=c(1, 1, 1)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=c("white", "red")) +
    expand_limits(x = 0, y = 0) +
    guides(x = guide_axis(angle=45)) + # angle
    theme_classic() +
    theme(axis.title.x=element_blank())
  
  if(any(c("*", "**", "***", "****") %in% pwc$p.adj.signif)) { # stat_pvalue_manual throws an error if no signif p.adj results
    pwc <- pwc |> add_xy_position(x = "Condition", fun = "max") # compute coords of p-values 
    plot <- plot + stat_pvalue_manual(pwc, label = "p.adj", hide.ns = T, 
                                      tip.length = 0.01)
  }
  plot
  saveThePlot(file.path(dir, paste0(measure, "_Responders_Plot")),  w = 3, h = 3.5)
}
```

Donor-aware analysis

```{r donor-aware, echo=FALSE}
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)

measures <- c("Baseline", "Cap.ENH_PC_Response", "AUC.Cap_ENH2", "Time.to.Peak.in.Cap_ENH2", "KCl_PC_Response")
for(measure in measures) {
  # Non-Responders
  ca_filter <- ca_data |> filter(Responder == 0)
  ca_filter$Condition <- relevel(factor(ca_filter$Condition), ref = "Vehicle")
  
  form <- as.formula(paste(measure, "~ Condition + (1 | Donor) + (1 | Coverslip)", sep=" "))
  fit <- lmer(form, data = ca_filter, REML = TRUE)
  summary(fit)
  capture.output(summary(fit), file = file.path(dir, paste0(measure, "_Non-Responder.txt")))
  confint(fit, parm = "Condition1", method = "Wald")
  
  #  Responders
  ca_filter <- ca_data |> filter(Responder == 1)
  ca_filter$Condition <- relevel(factor(ca_filter$Condition), ref = "Vehicle")
  
  form <- as.formula(paste(measure, "~ Condition + (1 | Donor) + (1 | Coverslip)", sep=" "))
  fit <- lmer(form, data = ca_filter, REML = TRUE)
  summary(fit)
  capture.output(summary(fit), file = file.path(dir, paste0(measure, "_Responder.txt")))
  confint(fit, parm = "Condition1", method = "Wald")
  
  #  All
  ca_filter <- ca_data
  ca_filter$Condition <- relevel(factor(ca_filter$Condition), ref = "Vehicle")
  
  form <- as.formula(paste(measure, "~ Condition + (1 | Donor) + (1 | Coverslip)", sep=" "))
  fit <- lmer(form, data = ca_filter, REML = TRUE)
  summary(fit)
  capture.output(summary(fit), file = file.path(dir, paste0(measure, "_AllCells.txt")))
  confint(fit, parm = "Condition1", method = "Wald")
}
```
